data: What is the approximate value of the green line at the x-axis value of 100 in the rightmost figure?

The green line represents the learning curve for the "emergent: select" language. The x-axis represents the number of epochs, and the y-axis represents training sequence accuracy. At the x-axis value of 100, the green line appears to be approximately at the 0.6 mark on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate value of the green line at the x-axis value of 100 is 0.6.
